# Preface

This book presents a practical analysis of e-commerce customer data to extract actionable insights for business strategy. We explore customer behavior patterns, identify key trends, and demonstrate how data analysis techniques can inform e-commerce decision-making.

The analysis is based on the [Kaggle E-Commerce Customer Dataset](https://www.kaggle.com/datasets/iyadavvaibhav/ecommerce-customer-device-usage), which includes valuable metrics on customer interactions, device usage, and purchasing behavior. The goal is to provide a clear framework for transforming raw data into strategic business insights.

For detailed results and conclusions, please refer to the next chapter.

**GitHub Repository**: [EcomLinearRegression](https://github.com/KushagraShukla30/EcomLinearRegression)
